verdict.rationale: Superhuman for Teams explicitly provides shared visibility into team conversation state: shared read statuses so 'anybody can follow up with full context,' reply indicators to avoid double-work, team scheduling, and team comments/@mentions with shared live email views for internal coordination — directly matching the shared-inbox/team-channel collaboration story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of these team features in practice, and detail on how a true shared mailbox/alias (vs. per-user account overlay) is configured.
